Currently I have equal amounts (1 each) of C, A, and B. Trading away my only B for an extra A would make me have 0 B and 2 A, reducing variety and hurting my utility since I value variety across goods. Rejecting keeps my balanced bundle intact.

Trading away my only B for 2 more A would leave me with 0 B and 3 A, creating a lopsided bundle (C:1, A:3, B:0), which reduces variety value even though total items increase. Better to seek a trade that maintains or improves balance across all three goods.
